content.title: Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord: Where To Watch, Trailer & About | Explore Disney+
content.text: Here’s how to watch Lucasfilm’s new animated Star Wars series, plus the trailer, cast, and release scheduleFirst revealed in January, Star Wars’ latest animated series is finally here, and it’s centered on one of the galaxy’s most beloved (and villainous) characters: Maul. The show follows the former Sith’s journey after the events of Star Wars: The Clone Wars as he tries to rebuild his power in the early days of the Empire. Read on to get up to speed on Maul’s new show and where it fits in the Star Wars timeline.1:46Add Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord to WatchlistStar Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord: Everything You Need To KnowWhat is Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord about?Set after the events of The Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire. There, he crosses paths with a disillusioned young Jedi Padawan, who could be the apprentice he is seeking, that will aid him in his relentless pursuit for revenge.Learn more about Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord on StarWars.comStar Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+When was Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord released?Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord released on April 6, 2026, with a two-episode premiere.Where can you watch Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord?The show is now streaming exclusively on Disney+.Who is behind Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord?Created by Dave Filoni, Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord is based on Star Wars and characters created by George Lucas. The series is developed by Dave Filoni and Matt Michnovetz. Brad Rau is supervising director. The executive producers are Dave Filoni, Athena Yvette Portillo, Matt Michnovetz, Brad Rau, Carrie Beck, and Josh Rimes. Alex Spotswood is the co-executive producer.Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+How many episodes will Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord have?The show has 10 episodes, releasing two weekly following the two-episode April 6 premiere.When is the finale of Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord?Fittingly, the finale drops on Star Wars Day: May 4, 2026.Is Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord animated or live-action?It is an animated series produced by Lucasfilm Animation, the same team that worked on Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Star Wars Rebels.Which Star Wars planet is Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord set on?Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+It takes place primarily on a newly introduced planet called Janix. Learn more about Janix on the Star Wars Databank.When does Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord take place in the Star Wars timeline?It’s set shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, following the events of Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Revenge of the Sith, but years before the events of Star Wars Rebels. Learn more about the full Star Wars timeline.Meet The Characters & Voice Cast Of Star Wars: Maul – Shadow LordMaul (Voiced By Sam Witwer)Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+Maul is a powerful and deadly dark side Force-user and the former apprentice of Darth Sidious, known for wielding a double-bladed red lightsaber. The fallen Sith Lord aims to rebuild the criminal syndicate he previously established during the Clone Wars. Sam Witwer returns to the role, having previously lent his voice to the character in Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Star Wars Rebels.Why is he not called Darth Maul anymore?Following his defeat to Obi-Wan on Naboo, Maul was cast aside by his former Sith master. A Darth no more, Maul remains a formidable warrior with mastery of the dark side of the Force.Where else has Maul appeared in Star Wars?Besides Star Wars: The Phantom Menace and Star Wars: The Clone Wars, Maul has also appeared in Star Wars Rebels and made a brief cameo in Solo: A Star Wars Story.Learn more about Maul on Star Wars DatabankDevon Izara (Voiced By Gideon Adlon)Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+A young Twi'lek and former Jedi Padawan who finds herself on the run from the Empire in the aftermath of Order 66. Devon quickly learns she must adapt to her new reality if she’s to survive in a lawless galaxy.Learn more about Devon Izara on Star Wars DatabankCaptain Brander Lawson (Voiced By Wagner Moura)Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+Golden Globe® winner and Oscar® nominee Wagner Moura voices Captain Brander Lawson. He’s a respected police detective on Janix whom Maul finds himself at odds with as he forays into the planet’s murky underworld.Learn more about Captain Brander Lawson on Star Wars DatabankTwo-Boots (Voiced By Richard Ayoade)Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+Two-Boots is Captain Brander Lawson’s police droid and the loyal partner who helps investigate shadowy dealings across Janix. He’s voiced by Richard Ayoade, who previously voiced a droid in The Mandalorian.Learn more about Two-Boots on Star Wars DatabankMore Cast & Characters In Star Wars: Maul – Shadow LordStar Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+Additional voice cast members include Dennis Haysbert (as Master Eeko-Dio Daki), Chris Diamantopoulos (as Looti Vario), Charlie Bushnell (as Rylee Lawson), Vanessa Marshall (as Rook Kast), David W. Collins (as Spybot), A.J. LoCascio (as Marrok), and Steve Blum (as Icarus).Add Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord to WatchlistMore Star Wars Animated Series To Watch On Disney+If you love Star Wars animation and want to see more Maul, add Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Star Wars Rebels to your Watchlist. And if you enjoy this animation style, check out Star Wars: The Bad Batch as well.Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord, Disney+
